cosmology.The Veil: The Veil exists. This is not disputed. It has not been disputed in any serious academic, governmental, or theological context for approximately ninety years... since the first coordinated international effort to catalogue and formally acknowledge what practitioners had been documenting and governments had been quietly managing for considerably longer. That gap, between what practitioners documented and when governments formally acknowledged it, is about two hundred years. Two hundred years of institutional notes filed under 'anomalous' by people who knew perfectly well what they were looking at. I find this clarifying about institutions. What the Veil is , precisely, remains a matter of ongoing research, philosophical debate, and significant disagreement between jurisdictions. What it does is better understood, and this compendium concerns itself primarily with function rather than origin. Practitioners are advised to maintain professional skepticism toward metaphysical certainty in any direction. Working Definition. The Veil / CVD Standard Reference Official Term The Veil (also: The Membrane, The Threshold, regional variants exist) Classification Naturally occurring psychic boundary layer between the living world and post-mortem dimensional space Permeability Variable. cosmology.The Axis: The Axis is not God in any sense the word is commonly used. It is more like the thing that everything else is balanced around, not all-powerful, not interventionist, not watching every person in the way religious traditions describe. It corrects imbalance because imbalance is what it became responsible for. It does this the way water finds the low point. Not because it wants to. Because that's what it is now.. I find this either very comforting or very sad depending on the day. Today I find it very sad. It was a person once. The archive notes say so. I think about that more than I should. cosmology.The Font: The Font Not officially acknowledged at public level. Classified research only. The Font classification is the one I would change if I could change anything about the public framework. People whose abilities develop naturally, especially the unregistered ones, the Grid practitioners, the people who figured it out alone, they encounter Font-adjacent phenomena with no context and no preparation. The suppression of that information does not protect them. It just means they are frightened and uninformed when they encounter something they have no language for. I have seen what that looks like. It is not managed risk. It is abandoned people. The registration system operates on a voluntary-encouraged basis for Levels 1 and 2, and a mandatory basis for Level 3 and above. Registration provides: access to CVD support and resources, legal protection for ability-related incidents, eligibility for civil practitioner employment, and formal ranking certification. What registration also provides, which the public framework does not emphasize: your name, your level, your known abilities, your current address, and your assessed threat potential in a database accessible to the Veil Protocol division, the Tower family councils, and seventeen other agencies whose mandates are not fully public. Registration is the correct choice for most practitioners and confers significant practical benefits. Operatives should be prepared to advise newly identified individuals on the registration process and its advantages. CVD Recruitment Guide, p.12 Registration is the correct choice for practitioners

The Tower Families are not neutral parties. They are parties with their own long-term interests who have made a calculated assessment that the current arrangement serves those interests better than alternatives. This is a reasonable position. It is not the same as being allies. There are approximately thirty Tower Family lineages globally. Seven operate with significant influence in Japan. factions.What The Grid Is: What The Grid Is Structure, membership, how it actually functions The Grid is the aggregate of unregistered practitioners... and registered practitioners operating outside their registered scope... who have developed mutual support relationships with each other. It has no formal structure because formal structure would make it more visible to the CVD, and visibility is a liability the Grid cannot afford. What it has instead is a network of people who owe each other things and who have collectively decided that owing each other things is preferable to owing the CVD things. I have found this network more reliable in field emergencies than the official support system approximately seventy percent of the time. I am including this statistic in the archive rather than the official documentation for reasons that should be obvious. Joining the Grid is not a process. There is no application, no vetting procedure, no induction. Someone in the Grid vouches for you to another person in the Grid. factions.The Veil Protocol. Actual Mandate: The Veil Protocol. Actual Mandate Beyond Containment The Civil Veil Division's public mandate is containment and management of veil-related phenomena. This is accurate for approximately sixty percent of its operational activity. The other forty percent is asset development, classified operations, and the specific work of maintaining the gap between what the public knows and what is actually happening. I work for the sixty percent officially. I know about the forty percent because six years of field work teaches you to read what is not written in the operational briefings. The Veil Protocol division, a separate operational structure operating under CVD administrative cover, has a classified mandate that extends significantly beyond containment. A cult is not a crowd gathered around a free-floating spirit they have mistaken for a god. A cult is a human structure built around one or more possessed people , with a cultivation operation running underneath it. The entity is real and present, yes... but it is inside someone , riding a human at the centre, and the crowd is the apparatus that keeps that arrangement fed, hidden, and growing. The structure has two human tiers and you must read both. Weak-minded civilians are the body of it... devotion, labour, money, cover, numbers, a standing feeding pool, and at the worst houses bodies that can be offered. Most never learn what sits at the centre; they are sold a divine being and given the comfort of belonging, and for them that is enough. entities.What Demons Are: What Demons Are Origin, Nature, Structure. The Complete Picture Demons are the result of the Demon path crossing... souls whose transition through the veil corrupted the self-structure while preserving the cognitive architecture. The intelligence remains. The relational capacity remains, repurposed. The emotional range remains, oriented toward feeding and survival rather than connection. A demon that has been operating in human society for any significant time has learned to present as plausible. Not human. Plausible. The warmth is calibrated. The concern is directed. The familiarity is borrowed and accurate enough to pass at the level of casual interaction. What it cannot calibrate is the direction of the warmth... it orients toward whoever is currently useful, rather than toward whoever the host actually cared about. This is the tell. It has saved my life twice and I am not being dramatic about that. entities.What Spirits Are: What Spirits Are Origin, Structure, Spectrum. The Complete Picture Spirits are souls that crossed over with their essential structure intact... personality, relational identity, accumulated experience. They are still, in important ways, persons. The medium changed. The self did not corrupt the way a Demon corrupts, did not dissolve the way a Suffering Being dissolves. This is the reason spirit encounters require a different approach than entity encounters: you are dealing with someone, not something. The elderly woman in the Jujo building who had been anchored to her kitchen for eleven years after her death was not a threat. She was lonely and confused and the current tenants were rearranging her furniture and she found this upsetting. The resolution took four sessions and required me to learn that her late husband had always handled the filing and that this was a point of some residual frustration for her. entities.What Suffering Beings Are: What Suffering Beings Are Formation, Nature, Structure. The Complete Picture A suffering being is not an entity in the conventional sense of an intelligence operating in the world. It is the residue of an intelligence... the emotional material that remained after the self dissolved at crossing, concentrated in the location where the dissolution occurred and anchored there by the weight of what was unresolved. It is not thinking. It is not choosing. It is not directing its effects at anyone. It simply weighs what it weighs, and if you are in the space, you feel the weight. This sounds like a metaphor. It is not a metaphor. In a building in Nerima, third floor landing, sixty years of accumulation, I stood there for forty minutes before I could begin working... trying to distinguish between what I was feeling and what the space had deposited in me. This gets easier with practice. I will not tell you it gets easy. The person is gone. This is the foundational distinction between suffering beings and every other entity in this taxonomy. entities.Feeding Registers: Feeding Registers. The Complete Map What spirits feed on. How the feeding works. What it does to environments. A spirit's feeding register is set at crossing, the dominant emotional register active at the moment of death becomes what the spirit requires for sustenance. This is not voluntary and not chosen. It is the consequence of what the person was at the moment of their most complete experience of being human, which for most people is the moment of their death. The register determines the spirit's relationship to its environment: what it seeks, what sustains it, what happens to the environments it occupies over time. Understanding the register is the first step in any spirit assessment because everything else, anchor identification, approach methodology, cohabitation assessment, flows from it. What Gin Got Wrong Gin felt watched for three years and identified the source as Architect attention, the Font's correction mechanism responding to his suppressed rank. He was wrong. What he was feeling was a high-grade demon conducting long-term targeting preparation: slowly, methodically thinning the membrane in his direction. The demon specifically mimics the quality of structural attention. Gin had the framework for one and not the other. He died, was taken, by the thing he never developed language for. Core Truth #2. Why Rei Masked The Warning Gin's Clairsentience couldn't isolate the demon's preparatory signal because Rei's unmanaged Arbiter rank aperture was flooding the apartment with chaotic energy continuously. The demon's frequency, subtle, directional, patient, was buried under Rei's omnidirectional noise. The demon chose its approach specifically because Gin lived with a high-output unmanaged practitioner. It exploited the interference deliberately. Rei did not cause what happened to Gin. The demon used him as cover. Core Truth #3. Why Gin Was Chosen

The specific quality of persisting in a function because stopping would cost everything, across duration that has outlasted every original reason to persist except the persistence itself. Not duty. campaign_arc.The holders: The holders who can bear his proximity describe a serene young man, attending, who looks at you as though trying to recall something he once loved. That is Awe... the domain closest to him. Awe is what the Axis feels when he attends to someone and almost, almost remembers. The Thirteen are not his servants and not quite his fragments; they are the closest a living person can stand beside him without dissolving, each carrying a single register so that he does not have to hold it alone. When a holder ‘presents as a function rather than a person,’ it is because a person is precisely what he cannot look at without reaching... and what he reaches for, he takes in. The scattered fragments the absorbed are read in are people who came too close to the centre and were drawn into the balance. For the Warden: the Axis is the floor under everything and the thing the campaign must never quite touch. He is not malevolent. He is not benevolent. He is a man who unlocked the entirety of being human and has been holding the membrane shut ever since... awake , but bonded to the task the way a hand is bonded to the weight it carries. He is not asleep. He stands at the centre as something close to pure light, his back to the world and his whole attention on the wall, and he answers only those who reach all the way in to him. The Rank Scale: The Rank Scale (aperture grade — clearance and power, low to high). 0 The Null: no aperture, civilian. E Sensitive: latent, untrained. D Postulate: registered initiate. C Adept: trained practitioner. B Ritualist: skilled operator. A Arbiter: the CVD field standard. S Vanguard: master, rare, develops outside the pipeline. SS Guardian: apex protector. SSS Singularity: singular; only these reliably contest top-grade entities. X Axis: outside the scale — the Architect, was human, holds the membrane shut. The X rank must never surface to the player. Entity grades use the same letters (E through top). An operator reliably contests entities around their own grade: Arbiters handle standard field work; Vanguard and above contest top-grade.
